spans.text: By the time Lee Enfield rushes to the scene, it's already in complete disarray.
Who the hell did this?!
How should I know?! The comms are jammed... Say, is everyone okay?!
Don't panic. Our leaders will be back soon!
I'm not scared... I'm not scared at all...
Type 56-1!
Leader!
Get ahold of yourselves! Such panic is unsightly!
56-1, what exactly is the problem that you mentioned in...
Lee Enfield enters the room and falls silent.
Her eyes are drawn immediately to MDR in the corner.
MDR is sitting there quietly as if she's asleep.
How did this happen...?
...Who was the first to discover her?
I was.
Gr G36c steps forward from the group.
I left the church and checked the surrounding rooms one by one.

When I got to this one, I noticed it was locked – it's the only room with a locked door. I thought whoever's behind this whole thing was in there, so I fired at the lock and broke in, only to find MDR collapsed over there.
Yeah, I was with Gr G36c. I can vouch for everything she said.
The door was locked from the inside?
Ja.
Lee Enfield walks toward the door. The lock has indeed been destroyed by a bullet. The mangled piece of metal is hanging like a broken rag doll on the wooden door.
She takes a look around – it's a rectangular room with no windows. All the walls are covered in wallpaper that shows no sign of damage.
Is this a so-called locked-room murder...?
D-Don't scare us, Leader! I think a ghost did this!
Isn't that even scarier of a thought...?
Miss Lee, Miss MDR's body bears no physical injury at all. This should be the result of an electronic assault.
PK, Sten, and Gr G36c, you three head back to the church with MDR's body.
Tokarev, Type 56-1, and Papasha, you're with me. We're searching the mansion again.
Haven't you already done that before?
There's a thunderstorm out there.
Under such tumultuous weather conditions, even T-Dolls can't leave the scene.
So if the culprit arrived after us, they must still be within the mansion.
...Which means we must've missed something.
Understood.
Are we staying behind as backup?
Why am I even in the backup group?
I'll get in touch with you once every hou- every half an hour to prevent another ambush from happening.
Ambush? You believe MDR was ambushed?
MDR is an outstanding T-Doll. If she'd caught sight of the culprit, she wouldn't have let herself be killed without putting up a fight.
If she hadn't even had the chance to fire a single shot, I'm inclined to think that the culprit dealt her a fatal blow from behind.
I see. Your reasoning is sound.
But...what if...it really was a ghost? Even the most outstanding T-Doll wouldn't stand a chance!
Ghosts don't exist in this world, Papasha.
Right, enough gloomy talk. We're splitting up, but we must take care not to be alone, so pair up.
Papasha, pull yourself together. This isn't like you at all. As a T-Doll, you mustn't let such fictitious nonsense get to you.
Eeep... Got it!
Tokarev, please stay with me.
56-1, go in the other direction with Sten. We're doing a thorough sweep in every room – don't let even a single bug get pass you.
Roger that!
